mapper.update: /*updateDeliveryRecordDeletePodt*/ UPDATE ICOMPODT A SET A.DI_QTY = DECODE(A.PROCESS_TYPE,'2',A.DI_QTY,(SELECT SUM(DELIVERY_QTY) FROM ICOMIVDT WHERE BUYER = A.BUYER AND PO_NO = A.PO_NO AND PO_SEQ = A.PO_SEQ AND STATUS != 'D')) WHERE A.BUYER = #{buyer} AND A.PO_NO = #{po_no} AND A.PO_SEQ = #{po_seq} AND A.STATUS != 'D'
